input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: explore: new research-algorithm tool, Gage R&R (measurement system analysis)
errors: Hand-worked 2x2x2 test expectations were wrong twice (within-cell SS 16 vs 8, total 61.5 vs 63.5); the engine and the statsmodels reference agreed, the hand arithmetic did not.

First nested reference used statsmodels C(operator)/C(part) with part labels unique to operator: rank-deficient, anova_lm crashed; replaced with differences of residual sums of squares between nested OLS fits.

doc_friction.issue: `example` passes a SAMPLE* constant as the first positional argument; an engine whose analyze() takes an options object needs the sample to be that object (or to accept a string). Took a describe/example round trip to discover; one sentence saying so would save it.
NIST/SEMATECH e-Handbook (itl.nist.gov), the natural public-domain source for gauge-study data, is refused by the proxy; cloud-session.md's 'Outbound hosts' list could name it.

deviations.why: No public real gauge-study dataset was reachable (NIST blocked), and inventing one would be fabrication.
deviations.did: Measured a real gauge study instead: three JavaScript timing harnesses on ten workloads, generated by a committed script, documented in data/SOURCE.md as one container's timings.
deviations.result: The example is real and reproducible in method, and it produced a genuine finding (single-call timing reads ~20% high).

notes: Explore idea: Gage R&R as a research-algorithm tool (ventures/gage-rr); 0 of 1,399 venture READMEs mentioned Gage R&R. Crossed ANOVA with interaction pooling, nested ANOVA, variance components, %SV/%contribution/%tolerance/%process, ndc, MLS intervals for every component (Graybill-Wang, Ting et al.). Verification: statsmodels 0.15.0 / numpy / scipy 1.18.1 to 1e-9 on 8 studies; 95% coverage 94.5-97.7% over 7 designs x 2,000 simulated studies; GRR lower bound floored at repeatability's (can only raise coverage). Playwright: both examples at 1200 and 375 px, no console errors or overflow. Local CI: run_workflow_locally.py --for-changes; first pass failed sibling-links (new tool had no inbound link) and prompts-ci (record still empty mid-run); fixed by footer links from spc-control-charts and method-comparison with tests, then rerun. Next: bias and linearity study.
